title: Aleksander Gierymski, Peasant from Bronowice, 500 CFA francs
descriptionPlain: Description Aleksander Gierymski is regarded as one of the finest Polish realists. In The Peasant from Bronowice, he focused on a single figure rendered with photographic precision, capturing the texture of the fabric and the natural play of light across the face and traditional attire. The coin faithfully reproduces the colours and detail of the painting, preserving its quiet, observational character.
